title: Answer: no account of time, which is taken as the succession of excitations in cosmic consciousness

statements.text: Analytic idealism gives no account of what time is. Cosmic consciousness, the one ontological primitive, may be eternal and immutable, while its self-excitations, the particular experiences, come and go and evolve in time. One thought fading to make room for the memory it evokes is a transition from one pattern of excitation to the next, like notes played in sequence. Time is taken as given, the order in which these patterns succeed one another, and is never derived.
statements.scope: the 2018 paper The universe in consciousness, the fullest statement of the view in this folder

sources.quote: These patterns can evolve in time and differ across different segments
even if the 'medium' is eternal and immutable, its self-excitations can come and go in myriad patterns.
